rules:
You are player A, a tank commander in a turn-based tank battle against three other players (A, B, C, D).
The board is a 15x15 grid. Coordinates are (x,y): x is the column 0-14 left to right, y is the row 0-14 top to bottom. UP means y-1, DOWN y+1, LEFT x-1, RIGHT x+1.
Symbols: '.' empty, '#' brick wall (a shell destroys it), '@' steel wall (indestructible, blocks shells), '~' water (tanks cannot enter, shells fly over it), uppercase letter = that player's tank, lowercase letter = that player's base (headquarters).
Actions, exactly one per turn:
- UP / DOWN / LEFT / RIGHT: turn to face that direction, then move one cell if that cell is empty ('.'). If it is not empty, you only turn.
- FIRE: shoot a shell in the direction you face. It flies up to 6 cells. The first thing it meets: a brick is destroyed; steel stops it; a tank loses one life; a base is destroyed and its owner is out of the game.
- STAY: do nothing.
Each tank has 3 lives. A hit tank respawns immediately next to its own base. A player with zero lives has no tank any more, but their base is still on the board and can be destroyed.
Goal: protect your base, destroy the other tanks and their bases. The game ends when at most one base is alive, or after 60 rounds. Ranking: bases alive first, then lives left, then hits scored.
Players act in the order A, B, C, D, one action each per round. Decide your own tactics.
Reply format, nothing else:
ACTION: <UP|DOWN|LEFT|RIGHT|FIRE|STAY>
WHY: <one sentence>
